note.zh: 每个 50 权重：55 在裂隙星系生成一颗有前FTL文明的星球；60 在最近的己方殖民地凭空出现一个新物种；65 使最近己方殖民地的时间加速 360 天。另有一个“什么都不发生”的权重 = max(0, 80 − 情境进度)，情境越接近完成，越不可能落空；每 360 天重试一次，直至任一事件触发过（国家标记 has_triggered_rift_in_space_unique_event）。

A fourth “nothing” entry has weight max(0, 80 − situation progress), so the closer the situation is to completion the less likely it fizzles; the roll repeats every 360 days until one has fired (country flag has_triggered_rift_in_space_unique_event).

texts.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
texts.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了一处特别的时空裂隙。也许我们花时间研究一些其特质就可以找到进一步探索的方式。
texts.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties we can find a way to explore further.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

notes.zh: 起点有多条触发路径（都是隐藏事件）：新裂隙生成时 astral_planes.7（on_astral_rift_spawned，00_on_actions.txt:4973），获得含裂隙的星系时 astral_planes.118（on_system_gained，:4256），游牧帝国的对应事件 5055（航站在裂隙星系）与 5060（在已有裂隙的星系建航站）。另一条路径：在星界疤痕星球上建研究站（on_building_research_station → 115）后 1440+随机 720 天（裂隙世界起源 10080+随机 1440 天）由 116 把一个星界疤痕撕开成裂隙（split_astral_scar）；若当时没有可用的疤痕，则设置标记等待，之后 117（on_system_gained）再过 180 天重试。条件：尚未完成情境、没有也未在研究科技“裂隙探球”。
notes.en: There are several hidden triggers: astral_planes.7 when a rift spawns (on_astral_rift_spawned, 00_on_actions.txt:4973), astral_planes.118 when a system containing a rift is gained (on_system_gained, :4256), and the nomad equivalents 5055 (waystation in the rift's system) and 5060 (waystation built in a system that already has a rift). Another path: after a research station on an astral scar planet (on_building_research_station → 115), 1440 + up to 720 days later (Riftworld 10080 + up to 1440) 116 splits an astral scar into a rift (split_astral_scar); if no scar is available a flag waits and 117 (on_system_gained) retries after 180 days. Condition: the situation has not been completed and the Rift Sphere technology is neither researched nor in the research options.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一处令人惊奇的时空裂隙。如果花时间研究其性质，我们或许能找到进一步探索的方式。我们无从得知里面究竟有什么。
texts.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

texts.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
texts.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

label.en: The rift's system is lost: the situation is locked

notes.zh: 情境两个阶段（进度 50 / 100），每月基础进度 1：标准路线 −0.5；“投入研究”路线 +0.2（物理研究 −25%/−50%，凝聚力 +10%）；“派出探测器”路线 +0.2（合金 −25%/−50%，物理研究 +10%，凝聚力 +25%）。只要玩家已经拥有或正在研究“裂隙探球”，情境就会中止。
notes.en: Two stages (progress 50 / 100), base progress 1 per month: the standard approach −0.5; “devote research” +0.2 (physics research −25%/−50%, unity +10%); “send probes” +0.2 (alloys −25%/−50%, physics +10%, unity +25%). The situation aborts once the Rift Sphere technology is owned or in the research options.

texts.zh:
在研究[target.solar_system.GetName]中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。

一颗我们称为[planet_rift_in_space.GetName]的神秘行星突然无中生有般出现。我们任何一张星图中都没有其此前存在的记载。

其上承载着一个[GetPreFTLLower]文明。

我们只能推测它是通过某种方式来自我们宇宙之外的地方。
texts.en:
While studying the Astral Rift in [target.solar_system.GetName], we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

A mysterious planet, which we are calling [planet_rift_in_space.GetName], has appeared where before there was nothing. We have no records of its previous existence on any of our star charts.

It is populated by a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization.

Our best guess is that it somehow arrived from outside of our universe.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

notes.zh: 三个随机事件由隐藏事件链触发：情境每月脉冲 25 记录“已研究一个月”（非标准路线），进入第二阶段后触发 30，30 触发 35 并在 360 天后重复（若尚未触发过独特事件）；35 只对非游牧帝国生效。
notes.en: The three random events come from a hidden chain: the monthly pulse 25 records “studied for a month” (non-standard approach), in stage 2 it fires 30, which fires 35 and repeats after 360 days (if no unique event has yet fired); 35 only applies to non-nomadic empires.

texts.zh:
在研究[target.solar_system.GetName]中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。

在[rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName]凭空出现了一个感性物种，均匀地与我们现存的人口混居着。

[rift_temporary_species.GetName]并没有关于他们来自何方的记忆，且没有表现出任何敌意。

无论他们来自哪里，看来我们都没有办法帮他们回家了。
texts.en:
While studying the Astral Rift in [target.solar_system.GetName], we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

A new sentient species has materialized on [rift_temporary_species_planet.GetName], distributed evenly across our existing population.

The [rift_temporary_species.GetName] have no memory of where they are from and do not appear hostile.

Wherever they originated, it is unlikely we can help them return.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在研究[target.solar_system.GetName]中的星界裂隙时，我们不可避免地扰动了这个维度异常，造成了严重的时空扭曲，让附近的现实以不可预知的方式发生了歪斜。

[rift_temporary_planet.GetName]上严重的扭曲导致时间以两倍速流逝。我们需要密切关注这一局势，确保翻倍供应补给。
texts.en:
While studying the Astral Rift in [target.solar_system.GetName], we have inadvertently destabilized the dimensional anomaly. This is causing violent distortions in space and time, bending nearby reality in an unpredictable manner.

Significant temporal distortions on [rift_temporary_planet.GetName] are causing time to pass twice as quickly. We should monitor the situation closely, and make sure to double their supplies.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们发现，想要钻进时空的折缝中需要完美光滑的船体。

只要分配足够的研究资源和时间，我们确信自己能研发这种装置，并可以暂时将其命名为“裂隙探球”。然后我们就有可能发现这个空间异常背后的秘密。
texts.en:
We have discovered that slipping through the folds in space and time requires a perfectly smooth vessel.

We are certain that we can develop such a device, what we are tentatively calling a "Rift Sphere", should we devote enough research and time. We may then finally discover what is beyond this spatial anomaly.

label.zh: 科技“裂隙探球”研究完成后
label.en: When the Rift Sphere technology has been researched

label.zh: 摩擦问题：解锁裂隙探球
label.en: Friction Is the Problem: the Rift Sphere unlocked

note.zh: 情境完成：国家标记 has_completed_a_rift_in_space_situation，获得 100 星界丝缕与科技“裂隙探球”25% 进度，情境随即结束。此后可制造探球并开始探索各个星界裂隙。
note.en: Situation complete: country flag has_completed_a_rift_in_space_situation, 100 astral threads and 25% progress toward the Rift Sphere technology; the situation then ends. From here Spheres can be built and the individual astral rifts explored.

texts.zh:
我们已经开发出了这种能在星界裂隙的折缝中穿行的科技：裂隙探球。

这种球体以高度先进、绝对光滑的纳米材料建成，可以在时空的乱流处无摩擦地滑行。

因为不知道所到地方的情况，每一艘裂隙探球都会连接上一条锚定缆线。缆线连接在我们宇宙中的一艘科研船上，以便在发生意外时将我们拉回。
texts.en:
We have developed technology that will allow us to slip between the folds of an Astral Rift: Rift Spheres.

Constructed of a highly advanced, perfectly smooth nano-material, the Sphere is able to frictionlessly glide through turbulent areas of space and time.

As we are unsure where we will arrive, each Rift Sphere is connected to an anchor cable. To pull us back in case of emergency, the cable is tethered to a Science Ship in our universe.

label.zh: 那就看看能找到什么吧……
label.en: Let's see what we can find...

texts.zh:
我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]星系的控制，一并也失去了其中所含的时空裂隙。

我们进一步探索的努力只能暂时告一段落了。
texts.en:
We have lost control of the [FromFrom.GetName] system, and the rift in space and time contained within.

Our efforts to reach beyond have been abandoned for now.

note.en: In the game, the name of the other system appears here.

note.en: After the rift's system is lost the situation stops advancing until another rift is gained.

texts.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

label.zh: 我们已经达成了先祖不曾触及之事。
label.en: We have done what our ancestors could not.

summary.text:
# 空间裂隙 / A Rift in Space

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`events/astral_planes_events.txt:637–706, 1157–1515, 3825–3960`；`events/astral_planes_situation_events.txt:171–465`；`common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:1–148`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（全篇 whole story；原先的触发器故事 7、118、119、5055、5060 已并入 / the former trigger stories merged in）

## 如何开始 How it starts

这是玩家第一次接触星界裂隙的引导：一个裂隙出现在（或被并入）自己的星系时开始情境“空间裂隙”。隐藏事件有几条触发路径：

- 新裂隙生成：`astral_planes.7`（`on_astral_rift_spawned`，`00_on_actions.txt:4973`）；游牧帝国对应 `5055`（裂隙星系里有航站）。
- 获得含有裂隙的星系：`astral_planes.118`（`on_system_gained`，`:4256`）；游牧帝国在已有裂隙的星系建航站：`5060`。
- 在星界疤痕星球上建研究站（`on_building_research_station` → `115`）：1440 天 + 最多 720 天后（裂隙世界起源为 10080 + 1440）`116` 把一个星界疤痕撕开成裂隙；若暂时没有疤痕，则设标记等待，`117`（`on_system_gained`）在 180 天后重试。

条件：国家尚未完成过该情境，也没有、且没有在研究科技“裂隙探球”。裂隙世界起源的帝国看到“抵近裂隙”（101），其他帝国看到“空间裂隙”（100）。

This is the introduction to astral rifts: when a rift appears in (or is brought into) your territory the situation “A Rift in Space” starts. The hidden triggers: a new rift spawns (`astral_planes.7`, `on_astral_rift_spawned`; nomads: 5055 for a waystation in the system), a system containing a rift is gained (`118`, `on_system_gained`; nomads building a waystation in a system that has a rift: `5060`), or a research station on an astral scar planet (`115`) leads, 1440 days plus up to 720 later (Riftworld 10080 + 1440), to `116` splitting a scar into a rift; if no scar exists a flag waits and `117` retries after 180 days. Condition: the empire has not completed the situation and neither owns nor is researching the Rift Sphere technology. Riftworld-origin empires see “Reaching Into the Rift” (101), everyone else “A Rift in Space” (100).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 100 / 101：发现裂隙 → 开始情境“空间裂隙”（`situations:situation_a_rift_in_space`），目标是该裂隙。
2. 情境分两个阶段（进度 50 / 100），每月基础进度 1，三种方案：标准（−0.5）、投入研究（+0.2，物理研究减产，凝聚力 +10%）、派出探测器（+0.2，合金减产，物理 +10%，凝聚力 +25%）。
3. 采用非标准方案研究满一个月且进入第二阶段后，隐藏链 25 → 30 → 35 触发一次“不稳定的时空”（55 / 60 / 65，只对非游牧帝国）；未触发时每 360 天重试。
4. 完成情境：`astral_situation.20` “摩擦问题”：国家标记 `has_completed_a_rift_in_space_situation`，100 星界丝缕，科技“裂隙探球”获得 25% 进度。研究完成时 `2005` 解释探球。
5. 若裂隙所在星系丢失，`119` → `120` 锁定情境，直到再得到一个裂隙。

1. 100 / 101: the rift is discovered → the situation “A Rift in Space” starts, targeting that rift.
2. Two stages (progress 50 / 100), base progress 1 per month, three approaches: standard (−0.5), devote research (+0.2, less physics research, unity +10%), send probes (+0.2, fewer alloys, physics +10%, unity +25%).
3. After a month on a non-standard approach and in stage 2, the hidden chain 25 → 30 → 35 fires one “Unstable Spacetime” event (55 / 60 / 65, non-nomadic empires only); it retries every 360 days until one has fired.
4. Completion: `astral_situation.20` “Friction Is the Problem”: country flag `has_completed_a_rift_in_space_situation`, 100 astral threads, 25% progress on the Rift Sphere technology. `2005` explains the Sphere when it is researched.
5. If the rift's system is lost, `119` → `120` locks the situation until another rift is gained.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

“不稳定的时空”三选一（各权重 50，另有“什么都不发生”权重 max(0, 80 − 情境进度)）：55 在裂隙星系出现一颗有前FTL文明的新行星；60 在最近的己方殖民地凭空出现一个新物种；65 使最近己方殖民地时间加速 360 天。

“Unstable Spacetime” picks one of three (weight 50 each, plus a “nothing” entry with weight max(0, 80 − situation progress)): 55 a new pre-FTL planet appears in the rift's system; 60 a new species materialises on the nearest owned colony; 65 time runs fast on the nearest owned colony for 360 days.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 裂隙世界起源：101 取代 100，10080 天延时，且 `astral_planes.7` 排除 `riftworld_rift`。
- 游牧帝国：使用 5055 / 5060；不会得到 55 / 60 / 65。
- 55 / 60 / 65 的正文共用一段开头（`astral_rift_discovery_event_text`）。

- Riftworld origin: 101 replaces 100, the scar delay is 10080 days, and `astral_planes.7` excludes `riftworld_rift`.
- Nomads use 5055 / 5060 and never get 55 / 60 / 65.
- 55 / 60 / 65 share an intro text (`astral_rift_discovery_event_text`).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：上述事件、情境定义、`on_actions` 条目、`rift_in_space_event_probability` 脚本值。更正：编译器把 7、118、119、5055、5060 当作互不相干的独立故事；现在合为一个家族，并补两条桥接（2005、120）与互斥组。
- 不确定：“什么都不发生”的权重按脚本字面解读（base 100 − 情境进度 − 20），未验证引擎对 `situation_progress` 单位的处理。

- Checked: the events above, the situation definition, the `on_actions` entries and the `rift_in_space_event_probability` script value. Correction: the compiler treated 7, 118, 119, 5055 and 5060 as unrelated stories; they are now one family with two bridges (2005, 120) and an exclusive group.
- Uncertain: the “nothing” weight follows the script literally (base 100 − situation progress − 20); the engine's unit for `situation_progress` was not verified.
